description: Describe how a CSV is actually shaped: the detected delimiter, the column count, ragged rows with their numbers, duplicate rows, and columns that are empty in every row. Choose this when you need to understand a file's shape — its delimiter, column count, ragged rows, duplicate rows and fully empty columns — before parsing it. Do not choose this when you want the file cleaned (use csv-clean), import errors diagnosed (use csv-preflight) or per-column statistics (use csv-column-profile). Example requests: What delimiter is this CSV actually using? | Report the shape of this CSV before I load it. | Why does this CSV import with the wrong number of columns?

accepted_price.description: The quoted amount, echoed exactly; checked against the quote.

authorized_by.description: Identifier of the human or agent authorizing this job.

buyer_token.description: The buyer_token returned with your first purchase. It opens the purchase history for that buyer, including earlier deliverables.

idempotency_key.description: Retry key; the same key returns the same job.

content.description: The customer's input.csv, as text. Supported: CSV, TSV or any delimiter-separated text. Maximum 1048576 bytes.
